vectors.note: CBRA, no Paging ID, 9A parameters (R_SFS 8 bitmap, 2 tau, 1 access occasion), SPPI 1 with a Security Parameter. Fields are raw values (codepoints). Fill bits are written as 0; the spec says the MAC entity ignores them, so only their count is compared on parse. r2d_tbs = PDU length in bytes: the spec says 'TBS of this message', and 38.291 §7.2.2 uses that value as the PRDCH transport block size, so the PDU is the TB (direct value, no offset; see README).

input.item: R2D TBS and D2R TBS encoding

vectors.note: The scheduling-info text spells out the 'first codepoint = first value' rule, so D2R TBS 1..125 is codepoint 0..124. The R2D TBS field (message header) says only 'the value can be {1..125} byte(s)'. These vectors take it as the direct binary value; if the field is also offset by one, every mac_pack/mac_parse vector except Access Trigger changes in the 7 TBS bits. Not resolvable from the text.
